title: The Machine Gun Jammed. The Emus Kept Coming.
description:
At a dam in Australia, soldiers faced a large flock of emus, but their machine gun jammed and the birds escaped. This film follows the army's attempts to stop the emus, from a difficult truck-mounted chase to the damage that continued even after the soldiers were called away.
